subject: AI is changing business – are you ready to lead?
message:
Juliette,AI is no longer just about technology. Today's leaders integrate AI strategically, govern it responsibly, and align it with sustainable business goals. As a Early stage VC investor associate in Venture Capital and Private Equity Principals, you're positioned to either lead that transformation or watch it happen.
The MSc Managing AI in Business from the award-winning University of Salford — winner of the Queen Elizabeth Prize for Education 2025 — delivered entirely online by Robert Kennedy College, Switzerland, gives you the strategic depth to drive AI-enabled transformation and the ethical grounding to lead it responsibly.
What you'll master:
✅ AI strategy: adoption frameworks, digital transformation, and value creation✅ Ethics and governance: bias, trust, and regulation for responsible AI✅ Sustainable technology: ESG, the Circular Economy, and the UN SDGs
Complete in as little as 12 months. Entirely online. Bursary up to CHF 3,200 available. Get our course catalogue and check your eligibility!
Best Regards,Prof. Dr. David Costa, DeanRobert Kennedy College🇨🇭Swiss Quality. Since 1998.
